principles: Official structural milestones define chronology but are not direct annual quality measurements.
FIFA Big Count 2006 evidence is gated from 2006 and is used primarily for participation/access context.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 evidence is gated from 2023 and does not backcast the modern professional ecosystem.
The 2008 LTPD, 2013 EXCEL pathway, 2015 infrastructure legacy and 2019 Canadian Premier League are represented as distinct structural steps.
Current 2026 participation and club-network facts are current-only and do not rewrite earlier years.
No ranking or title outcome is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains reserved for world-leading system dimensions.
